#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    string underScore;
    string bracket;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ) {
        if (s[i] == '(') {
            i++;
            for (; s[i] != ')'; i++) {
                bracket += s[i];
            }
            i++;
            bracket += '_';
            underScore += '_';
        } else {
            underScore += s[i];
            i++;
        }
    }

    underScore += '_';
    bracket += '_';

    int max = 0;
    stringstream ss1(underScore);
    string segment;
    while (getline(ss1, segment, '_')) {
        if ((int)segment.length() > max) {
            max = segment.length();
        }
    }

    int max2 = 0;
    stringstream ss2(bracket);
    while (getline(ss2, segment, '_')) {
        if (!segment.empty()) {
            max2++;
        }
    }

    cout << max << " " << max2 << endl;

    return 0;
}
